D.t: Jason Crow leads by 30.9 in the forecast and wins 100% of simulations. The cushion is about 109,811 votes; a one point swing is about 1,776 voters changing sides.
In 8 of 10 simulations the result lands between D +23.2 and D +37.9. Only an unusual polling error changes the winner.
